Deputy Vice President (Digital Marketing): Bachelor's degree in Marketing / Business Administration / Mass Communication / Digital Marketing, or related field. Experience: Minimum 10 Years' post qualification experience in the field of marketing in e-Commerce/ Banking Industry/ Fintech Company/ Information Technology or a consumer-facing company. To apply directly, use the Apply Online link provided in the Important Links section.
Alternatively, candidates may visit the official website of SBI to complete the application.

Upload required documents such as photograph, signature, and certificates in the prescribed format.
Pay the application fee online, if applicable.
Review all details carefully before submitting the form.
Take a printout or save a copy of the submitted application for future reference.

content_sections.text: Candidates who meet the eligibility criteria can apply online for the SBI Various Posts Recruitment 2026. Applications must be submitted online on or before 21-10-2026. To apply directly, use the Apply Online link provided in the Important Links section. Alternatively, candidates may visit the official website of SBI to complete the application. faq.question: Q1. What is the organization conducting this recruitment?
faq.answer: The recruitment is being conducted by the State Bank of India (SBI) for Specialist Cadre Officer positions under advertisement number CRPD/SCO/2026-27/24 on a contract basis.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available in SBI SCO Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are a total of 4 vacancies available across different posts including Deputy Vice President and Content Specialist roles for qualified professionals.

faq.question: Q3. What is the start date to apply online?
faq.answer: The online application process officially commences on 30 September 2026, allowing eligible candidates to submit their applications through the official website.

faq.question: Q4. What is the last date to submit the application form?
faq.answer: The final date to complete and submit the online application form is 21 October 2026. Candidates are advised to apply early to prevent network congestion.

faq.question: Q5. What is the minimum qualification required?
faq.answer: Applicants must hold a Bachelor's degree in relevant fields such as Marketing, Business Administration, Statistics, Data Science, Computer Science, Mass Communication, Journalism, or Advertising depending on the post.

faq.question: Q6. What is the age limit for Deputy Vice President posts?
faq.answer: For the Deputy Vice President positions, candidates must be between 33 and 45 years of age as per the specified guidelines in the official notification.

faq.question: Q7. What is the application fee for General and OBC candidates?
faq.answer: General, EWS, and OBC category candidates are required to pay an application fee of Rs. 750, whereas SC, ST, and PwBD candidates are exempted from the fee.

faq.question: Q8. What is the salary offered for these positions?
faq.answer: The salary for the Specialist Cadre Officer positions goes up to Rs. 63 lacs per annum, varying according to the specific post and candidate experience profile.

faq.question: Q9. What is the selection process for SBI SCO?
faq.answer: The selection process typically comprises shortlisting of candidates based on eligibility, followed by an interview session and subsequent CTC negotiation.

faq.question: Q10. Where can I apply for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Eligible candidates can apply online by visiting the official SBI careers website at https://sbi.bank.in/web/careers/current-openings before the last date.
